scope: Read-only canonical voice-pipeline/API review and isolated host decoder experiments; production unchanged.
language_policy: Explicit pa remains Punjabi; neither hi nor ur is substituted. Latin names/codes are not blanket-suppressed.
safe_experiment_constraints: Same pinned model/audio bytes, explicit language and two threads for all profiles.
Search and hint settings isolated before combining.
Preserve canonical abort/encoder cancellation and per-request native model cleanup.
Run empty/noise/tone controls for any initial prompt.
A forced language code is not automatic independent language identification.
Retain raw transcript and script counts; do not call cross-script Punjabi WER a fair linguistic score.
prompt_caveats: initial_prompt is previous-transcript conditioning, not an instruction contract.
no_context clears history before prompt insertion; it does not prevent prompt contamination.
Temperature fallback can alter effective search and omit prompt at higher temperatures.
no_speech_caveats: Native skip requires both high no-speech probability and low internal sequence average log-probability. Confident false output can survive.
A 100ms energy gate rejects digital silence/quiet noise but does not distinguish louder noise or tone from speech.
Our direct native control harness bypasses the Android energy gate; silence/quiet-noise false output must be separated from reachable higher-noise/tone behavior.
script_api_caveat: Visible and appliance recording currently snapshot a primary language; SpeechController strips any script subtag before native JNI. Full-tag snapshot and raw/display transcript types would be required for any later evidence-backed script-sensitive feature.
memory_caveat: 180MiB model-size guard excludes Small Q5_1 at190085487bytes (~181.28MiB). Reserve max(modelBytes*4+128MiB,256MiB) must also fit75% available RAM; target2GB device is unattached.
host_limits: Actual Linux x86_64 JNI/Whisper/model inference, not Android recording or phone acceptance.
Generic host GGML SIMD flags are OFF. Timing/RSS cannot predict ARM/NEON speed or physical2GB stability.
Some candidate/model runs overlap under a four-inference-thread cap; report timing as shared-host observations.
